controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack applicable to the project defines an ownership principle (named business owner per data domain); this principle is formally adopted and its application is verifiable on the audited scope.
controls.verification: Verify that the profile's Data by Design principles pack defines an ownership principle, then check, for a sample of data domains within the scope, the actual presence of a named owner in compliance with this principle.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the principles pack (definition of the ownership principle) + sample of data domains with a named owner.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined in the pack and applied to 100% of the checked sample ; partial = principle defined but partial application ; non-compliant = principle absent from the pack or not applied
actions_audit: Verify that the profile's Data by Design principles pack covers ownership.
Sample data domains within the scope and verify the presence of a named owner.
If gap: have the principles pack completed or have the missing owners designated.
standards: RGPD — art. 24 (responsabilité du responsable de traitement)

controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a validated modeling principle (review by a data authority before going into production); this principle is applied to every data model delivered within the audited scope.
controls.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers modeling validation, then check that a sample of recently delivered data models bears a record of review by the data authority before going into production.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (validated modeling principle) + review reports for a sample of delivered models.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and review recorded for 100% of the sample ; partial = principle defined with partially recorded reviews ; non-compliant = principle absent or no review recorded
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers validated modeling.
Sample recently delivered data models and verify the record of review by the data authority.
If gap: have the pack completed or establish the missing modeling review.
standards: ISO/IEC 25012:2008 — modèle de qualité des données

controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a measured quality principle (declared rules and thresholds, continuous control); this principle is applied to the critical data domains within the audited scope.
controls.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers measured quality, then check that a sample of critical domains actually applies quality rules with thresholds and continuous execution.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (measured quality principle) + sample of rules/thresholds applied per critical domain.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and applied to 100% of the critical sample ; partial = partial application ; non-compliant = principle absent or not applied
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers measured quality.
Sample critical domains and verify the actual application of quality rules with thresholds.
If gap: have the pack completed or instrument the missing quality rules.
standards: ISO/IEC 25012:2008 — modèle de qualité des données

controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a data protection by design principle (classification, minimization, proportionate measures); this principle is applied to every personal or sensitive data domain within the audited scope.
controls.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers protection by design, then check that a sample of domains processing personal or sensitive data bears a classification and proportionate protection measures.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (privacy by design principle) + sample of classifications and protection measures applied.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and proportionate measures applied to 100% of the sample ; partial = classification present without complete measures ; non-compliant = principle absent or sensitive data not classified
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers data protection by design.
Sample domains processing personal/sensitive data and verify classification and measures.
If gap: have the pack completed or apply the missing protection measures.
standards: RGPD — art. 25 (protection des données dès la conception et par défaut)

controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a native usability principle (every data domain is exposed via a published, integrable data contract); this principle is applied to domains intended for cross-functional sharing.
controls.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers native usability, then check that a sample of cross-functionally shared domains publishes an up-to-date data contract.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (usability principle) + sample of published data contracts.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and contract published for 100% of the shared sample ; partial = partial or outdated contracts ; non-compliant = principle absent or no contract published
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers native usability.
Sample cross-functionally shared domains and verify the publication of an up-to-date data contract.
If gap: have the pack completed or publish the missing data contracts.

controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines an observability principle (monitoring of freshness, volume, and lineage); this principle is applied to the critical data domains within the audited scope.
controls.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers data observability, then check that a sample of critical domains has active monitoring (alerting, viewable lineage).
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (observability principle) + monitoring captures (alerting, lineage) for the sample.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and active monitoring on 100% of the critical sample ; partial = partial monitoring ; non-compliant = principle absent or no monitoring
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers data observability.
Sample critical domains and verify the existence of active monitoring (alerting, lineage).
If gap: have the pack completed or instrument the missing monitoring.
standards: ISO 8000-8 — qualité de l'information : concepts et mesure

controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a knowledge and cataloging principle (every asset in production is described and discoverable); this principle is applied to the data assets in production within the audited scope.
controls.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers cataloging, then check the coverage and freshness of the descriptions of a sample of assets in production in the catalog.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (cataloging principle) + extract from the catalog showing coverage and freshness for the sample.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and 100% of the sample cataloged and up to date ; partial = incomplete coverage ; non-compliant = principle absent or absence of a catalog
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers cataloging and discoverability.
Sample assets in production and verify their presence and freshness in the catalog.
If gap: have the pack completed or catalog the missing assets.
standards: FAIR Principles (GO FAIR, 2016) — Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable

controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a governed accessibility principle (traced and reviewed authorizations, access proportionate to classification); this principle is applied to the data domains within the audited scope.
controls.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers governed accessibility, then check that a sample of domains has an authorization matrix that is traced and periodically reviewed.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (governed accessibility principle) + authorization matrix and last review date for the sample.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and matrix up to date (reviewed ≤ 12 months ago) for 100% of the sample ; partial = matrix existing without a recent review ; non-compliant = principle absent or absence of a matrix
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers governed accessibility.
Sample data domains and verify the existence and freshness of the authorization matrix.
If gap: have the pack completed or update the missing authorization matrices.

controls.regle: The Data by Design principles pack defines a sustainability principle (full lifecycle managed: retention, archiving, purging, proven restoration capability); this principle is applied to the critical data domains within the audited scope.
controls.verification: Verify that the principles pack covers lifecycle sustainability, then check that a sample of critical domains applies a retention policy and has a tested restoration capability.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the pack (sustainability principle) + retention policies and latest restoration test reports for the sample.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = principle defined and lifecycle managed/proven for 100% of the sample ; partial = partial management (retention without restoration test, or vice versa) ; non-compliant = principle absent or lifecycle not managed
actions_audit: Verify that the principles pack covers sustainability and the data lifecycle.
Sample critical domains and verify the retention policy and restoration test.
If gap: have the pack completed or establish the missing lifecycle management.
